outcome: Brain reactivity during emotional face matching task
cohort: Healthy women assessed within 48 hours after delivery and again 4-6 weeks postpartum (n=13), and naturally cycling women assessed during the luteal and follicular phases of their menstrual cycle (n=15)
finding: Healthy women had lower reactivity in the insula, middle frontal gyrus, and inferior frontal gyrus in early postpartum compared to late postpartum, and reactivity in the insula and inferior frontal gyrus was greater in postpartum women than in non-pregnant controls.
